contexts.text: When the cause is taken away... the effect is dissolved and falls to pieces.
Unless the natural mind reacted... the interiors would relax themselves... and thus fall to pieces.
What they build up by day falls to pieces in the night.
Unless it depended upon one, every divided thing would fall to pieces of itself. Example(s).
It is this unity which effects the preservation of the whole, which would otherwise fall to pieces...
